What We Make of Free Rein: my new collection, released one painting at a time

November 22, 2026 · By Kimberly Marnell

I have started the most ambitious body of work I have made. What We Make of Free Rein is a ten-piece contemporary collection, and I am releasing it slowly, one original painting at a time.

What the collection is about

Free Rein is a modern, expressive collection about the figure, nature, light, and the freedom to create, grow and define a life of our own making. It grows out of the question I keep returning to in my work: what might we discover about ourselves if we begin making, growing and creating again?

The women in my paintings are usually in a private moment, eyes closed or lowered, with a flower or the natural world close by. In Free Rein I am pushing that further, with bolder color, looser gesture and more of the freedom the title promises. I believe these will be the strongest paintings I have made.

Why one painting at a time

Each painting gets the time it needs. Rather than finishing all ten and opening them at once, I will release each original when it is ready, with its full details: title, medium, size, year and price. It also means every painting has its own moment, and collectors have time to consider each one properly.

You can follow the collection on its page, which shows how many of the ten have been released so far.

How collectors see each work first

New paintings go to my collector list first, a few days before they appear online. If you would like the first look at each Free Rein original, email me to join the list. I will send each painting as it is finished, with photographs and the details you need to decide.

Reserving a painting

When a painting speaks to you, you can buy it outright, or on originals over $2,000, pay in three monthly payments. Major works are reserved by email and invoiced. Every original ships with a signed certificate of authenticity and ships free and insured within the US.

I can't wait to share the first one with you.
